summary: I am a WhatsApp automation developer who needs to manage groups programmatically. The proposed solution fills a real gap — no official or unofficial tool gives me reliable, non-scraping group management APIs. However, I would NOT buy it at launch because I have no trust in the provider's reliability, the ban risk remains unclear, and I can currently stitch together free open-source libraries to get by (even if it's painful). My willingness to pay is low because I'm used to free or cheap workarounds, and any paid solution must prove it avoids bans better than what I already have.
strongest_points: The core problem is real — there is NO official WhatsApp API for group management, and all unofficial solutions carry ban risk or require self-hosting
If this solution could guarantee no account bans through a legitimate technical approach (not scraping), I would switch immediately
The global applicability is strong — groups are used everywhere, not just in one region
weaknesses: I am extremely skeptical of any third-party claiming WhatsApp group APIs — most are just scraping WhatsApp Web under the hood, and I've seen accounts banned with those
My current 'workaround' using free libraries (Baileys, whatsapp-web.js) costs me $0. I need a VERY compelling reason to pay monthly for something I can hack together
You haven't mentioned how this solution avoids WhatsApp banning my account — without a clear technical explanation or official partnership, I won't trust it with real group operations
